research.method: Read-only scout inspected product positioning and workflows; Main checked the specific primary-source passages and reviewed whether the proposed task required the proposed owner decision.

sources.finding: Private agent use and public publication are both explicitly supported.
Current-project discovery and reconciliation end with a reviewable local diff.
A private trial preserves the current checkout and uses an isolated worktree and loopback preview.
Purpose depends on owner intent; broader use cases are exploratory, and research-resolvable questions should not be routed to the owner.

research.candidate: When bounded documentation effort cannot improve both maintainer and downstream reader outcomes, which should take priority?
research.proposed_reader_task: Choose the safe trial versus current-project start path, explain the workflow boundaries, and identify whether the resulting corpus may serve private agents or public readers.
research.disposition: Rejected by Main. The proposed task is already answered by existing workflow and audience documentation. No concrete conflict was found that requires a global priority tie-break. Missing an abstract product-priority sentence is not evidence of consequential missing owner knowledge.
other_candidates_rejected: Broadening beyond software documentation is not a new requirement established by this experiment.
Existing release/help checks can be researched without inventing owner policy.
Generated-to-authored conversion mechanics were already resolved through source and runtime evidence in inquiry-002.

execution.reason: No consequential owner-dependent task selected. Do not freeze an artificial test merely to continue the workflow.

revisit_condition: A real documentation or adoption task encounters a consequential intent question that the existing material and source/runtime investigation cannot resolve. Freeze that task, evidence and criteria before capturing its answer.
limitations: This bounded search does not establish that all owner intent is documented.
No interview, reader improvement, time saving, or causal benefit was measured.
This research disposition does not complete GPS-296's foreign-repository adoption proof.
